subject: science
title: Animals, Including Humans
description: How animals grow, what they need to survive, and staying healthy.

objectives.statement: Notice that animals, including humans, have offspring which grow into adults.
Find out about and describe the basic needs of animals, including humans, for survival (water, food and air).
Describe the importance for humans of exercise, eating the right amounts of different types of food, and hygiene.

items.prompt: What is a baby frog called?
What is a baby sheep called?
Which order is correct for how a butterfly grows?
What is a baby cow called?

items.statement: A duckling grows into a duck.
Kittens look completely different from cats when they grow up.

items.prompt: Name the three things all animals need to survive.

items.answer: Their bodies need water to work and stay alive

items.prompt: Which of these is NOT a basic need of animals?
As well as food, water and air, what helps animals stay safe and well?

items.statement: All animals, including humans, need air to breathe.

items.prompt: Why is exercise good for you?
items.answer: It keeps your heart, muscles and body strong and healthy
acceptableAnswers: it keeps you fit and healthy

items.prompt: Name two things you should do to keep your teeth healthy.
items.answer: Brush them twice a day and avoid too many sugary foods and drinks
acceptableAnswers: brush your teeth and eat less sugar

items.prompt: Which meal is the healthiest choice?
Why do we wash our hands before eating?

items.statement: Eating sweets every day is good for your teeth.
Sleep helps your body grow and repair.

items.prompt: What do we call animals that only eat plants?
What do we call animals that eat both plants and meat?
Which of these animals is a carnivore?
Which of these animals hatches from an egg?

items.statement: Fish breathe air with lungs, just like humans.
